translations.web: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
translations.bsb: At this, I said, ‘I have been banished from Your sight; yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple.’
translations.kjv: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
translations.asv: And I said, I am cast out from before thine eyes; Yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
